description: Search the curated specialty coffee cafe database by name, city, country, roaster, and minimum quality score. Returns scored results sorted by espresso-quality score descending.

city.description: Filter by city name (case-insensitive exact match).

country.description: Filter by ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'JP', 'DK', 'US').

limit.description: Maximum number of cafes to return. Default 20.

query.description: Free-text query matched against cafe name, city, district, and notes (case-insensitive).

roaster.description: Filter to cafes that roast in-house under this name, or serve beans from this roaster.

name: search_cafes
title: Search Curated Cafes
